title: AdvanCT EURAMET project, CEA XCT scan data, NPL sample, robot scan
description:
Raw stack of 141 X-ray projections (corrected and logarithmized) acquired along a robot trajectory

SinoLog141proj_inv : size 1024 x 1024 x141, 32 bit Real

Acquisition parameters :

- X-ray tube Viscom XT9225 -DED operating at 160 kV, 80 µA, 

- X-ray detector : Perkin Elmer XRD0822 (1024 x 1024 pixels, 200 µm) 1 s integration time

Robot trajectory : semi-circular (140°) with SDD = 50 cm and SOD = 25 cm
